driver.format: Bun TypeScript; imports existing versioned measurement helpers via REPO_PATH

limitations: Local OrbStack Linux aarch64, 2 CPU / 1 GiB, no extra swap, 64 pids, init, read-only code/model, non-root, loopback HTTP published only to 127.0.0.1. No actual VPS, HTTPS, x86_64 or long-duration/many-room/max-history test.

Worker integration uses a moving clock shifted into the future to prevent native alarms from racing explicit calls. Real network/PyTorch and all process/service/model IDs are used. Native 2-second delay and clock charging are verified in deterministic integration tests; elapsed in this report starts at CPU request, not turn start.

Comparison is a bounded driver using the same actual Linux CPU service/profile budgets plus frozen Lv2 on Mac, not the Worker game clock. It waits 20ms between GETs, starts timing after health, allows 4s lifetime and excludes minimum 2s wait. It simulates D05 with fixed Lv2 only after explicit model_not_used. No service/network fault is silently accepted.

One tuning opening series per rule, four seats, sixteen additional plies. All sixteen matches unfinished. One candidate checkmate in each four-game group, one opponent family, no independent strength/monotonicity inference. No public levels/uncalibrated win percentages promoted.

Failed job phase timing fields of zero mean unavailable detailed telemetry, not proof of no inference work. Model uses count only predictions adopted by the completed search; model_not_used consumes time and falls back explicitly.

T02 actual VPS, T03 public levels/official limits, T05 long-term retention remain deferred. Raw reports/models temporary; model weights not added to Git. CPU selection/source diagnostics are room-scoped and finite, not permanent billing/audit records.
